scope: Literal canonical covariance-gap specialization of Corollary4

passages.claim: The actual covariance gap is computed as1-maxOffDiagonal, including the one-coordinate empty-family convention. Its defining finite-max inequality supplies every pairwise gap condition, so positivity of the actual gap alone yields the literal printed delta*gSigma*L*sqrt(1+log1/c) rate.
